subject: MAP playbook sanity check + RACI walkthrough — Acme Robotics POC
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP + RACI for Acme POC — please review before internal dry run

Team —

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan for Acme's pilot (attached: MAP-playbook-acme-draft-v1.xlsx). I want to get internal alignment before we pull in Jared and the Acme stakeholders next Wednesday. High-level asks: 

- Quick sanity check on milestones (column B–E) — any missing gating items?
- RACI: confirm who from our side will be accountable/owners for each milestone — I've put provisional owners in the sheet.
- Evaluation criteria: we need a concise 3-metric success definition for the POC (latency target, per-token cost range, and SLO for availability) — please suggest concrete numbers.

Proposed timeline snippet (from the sheet):
- Week 0 (Dec 6): internal dry run + finalize MAP
- Week 1–2: environment provisioning + initial eval dataset upload
- Week 3: baseline eval + performance tuning
- Week 4: joint demo + close decision

Prep for the internal dry run: 30–45 min sync on Dec 6, 10:00–10:45 PT. Please confirm availability or propose alt times.

Notes about the RACI column: I've used R = Responsible (day-to-day), A = Accountable (single owner), C = Consulted, I = Informed. Example rows to check: 
- "Env provisioning" -> R: Markus, A: Vivek, C: Monica
- "Evaluation harness" -> R: Monica, A: Tessa

Attachments: MAP-playbook-acme-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP + milestone tracker)
SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (reference — Acme asked about SOC2 evidence during discovery)

Thanks — rapid turnaround appreciated, Jared expects a finalized draft to circulate to their team on Dec 7.

—
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + RACI for Acme POC — please review before internal dry run

Tessa — quick pass done. High-level comments below; I'll add line comments in the sheet.

1) Milestones: add a pre-provision checklist row for "SSH access + KMS key exchange" (we hit a snag with Acme on a previous pilot when keys weren't pre-exchanged). Suggest inserting between "Contract signed" and "Env provisioning".

2) RACI tweaks: I'm comfortable being R for provisioning but would prefer A -> Monica for end-to-end delivery. That keeps a single accountable PM for the POC.

3) Evaluation targets (proposal):
   - Latency: p95 inference latency <= 220ms (demo tokens, 1k contextual tokens)
   - Cost: target normalized token cost <= $0.0025 per input+output token for the pilot workload
   - Reliability: sustained 99.5% availability during baseline run window

4) Ops item: can we add a rollback/fallback row — plan to fallback to hosted model variant if dedicated capacity spike occurs? This should be C: Vivek, A: Monica.

I'll be on the dry run on Dec 6; confirming yes for 10:00 PT.

-Markus
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-04T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + RACI for Acme POC — please review before internal dry run

Thanks for pulling this together, Tessa. A few short notes: 

- I accept A for delivery (Markus, thanks for the suggestion). I'll make sure the engagement owner fields and success criteria are in the one-line summary for the execs.
- I'll add the SSH/KMS row and the rollback/fallback entry.
- For evaluation dataset, let's call out who owns the sample prompts and what counts as a failed run (e.g., hallucination rate > 5% on a 200-sample controlled set). Monica -> R for dataset prep, Tessa -> C for prompt rubric.

Confirming Dec 6, 10:00–10:45 PT for the dry run. Agenda for the sync (30–40 min):
1) Quick read of MAP (5 min)
2) RACI walk — confirm A/R for each milestone (15 min)
3) Evaluation metrics and pass/fail thresholds (10 min)
4) Action items + owners + next steps (5 min)

I'll make edits in the sheet tonight and flag outstanding decisions.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-05T16:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + RACI for Acme POC — please review before internal dry run

All — thanks for the quick turn. A couple of practical items before the dry run tomorrow:

- I'll prepare a short runbook excerpt for the Env provisioning row (network CIDRs, KMS key owner, certs, expected time to provision). Will upload as "provisioning-runbook-snippet.md" to the Drive link.
- Suggest we add a "Decision checkpoint" row on Day 14 to capture business criteria for moving to paid pilot (owner: Monica, approver: Acme procurement).
- On the fallback plan: agree we should include a perf/regression test to validate hosted variant compatibility — Markus to own the smoke test.

Minor wording proposal for the MAP intro paragraph: change "goal: demonstrate feasibility" -> "goal: demonstrate production-readiness for a 1–2 region deployment" (helps purchasing see scale intent).

See you all at 10:00 PT. I'll drop the runbook excerpt and a 1-page exec summary into the Drive folder before the meeting.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
